#[account]
#[derive(InitSpace)]
pub struct PlayerData {
    pub wood: u64,
    pub energy: u64,
    pub last_login: i64,
}

#[derive(Accounts)]
pub struct InitPlayer<'info> {
    #[account(
        init,
        payer = signer,
        space = 8 + PlayerData::INIT_SPACE,
        seeds = [b"player", signer.key().as_ref()],
        bump,
    )]
    pub player: Account<'info, PlayerData>,
    #[account(mut)]
    pub signer: Signer<'info>,
}

#[derive(Accounts)]
pub struct InitBoard<'info> {
    #[account(
        init,
        payer = signer,
        space = 8 + 12 * (1 + 128),
        seeds = [b"board", signer.key().as_ref()],
        bump,
    )]
    pub board: Account<'info, Board>,
    #[account(mut)]
    pub signer: Signer<'info>,
    pub system_program: Program<'info, System>,
}
